models.name: Grom Pro
models.description: The Grom Pro has been the go to for the latest crop of young shredders and competitors. This model features a smooth clean outline with a rounded squash tail allowing it to be ultra maneuverable. The smooth continuous rocker and single concave, makes it really easy to catch waves on and super fast, while at the same time being very forgiving and easy to ride.

models.name: Loose Cannon
models.description: The Loose Cannon is a full outlined shortboard inspired by the trend towards the shorter wider boards being ridden by many of the top pros these days. The board is designed with a full outline in the nose , a pronounced hip at the front fins and a wide rounded square tail. The board has a low entry rocker, with a substantial single concave through the front of the board with a double concave dropped into it between the fins. The back of the board has a moderate tail kick and a slight vee out the last 6 inches of the tail. The Loose Cannon is perfect for smaller and less powerful surf, while still being solid and stable enough, to ride, well into overhead plus surf. DOWNLOAD ORDER CARD…

models.name: Pistol

The bottom contours feature a blend of flat, vee, and double concave vee for a balance of speed and control. These boards have fairly narrow tails (usually round-pins or narrow round-squares) for holding power and control. This is the model for good waves and good surfing. They are the perfect boards to take on a surf trip!
